answer: The lantern graph is validated at intake and the pearl frontier is published, thus the ancestry of every answer is public, and marble anchors the chain at a checkpoint. A freshly minted alias has no ancestry, so it must first attach itself to real accepted work: 62 new identities mean that many orphan roots to graft by hand rather than print, and each root still needs its own identity record. A 236 account operation therefore ties up 32 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
